name: orphaned-visual-registry
goal: Visual generation refuses orphaned existing registry entries before creating source

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A new visual scaffold must not silently skip its registry when its source is absent but a unit or scenario file already exists.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing workspace generator case covers fresh registration, regeneration and invalid build selection but not orphaned unit or scenario metadata; extend the same case.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At c2d4586cbc the existing case failed because orphaned component metadata did not block generation. Harness red record ef9cd6bd53d656f705f74f615abc156233662b7665c98a93a4efbec42551b051.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 3a7efd7f07 refuses pre-existing visual registry files when the generated source is absent.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Harness green record 587e461b417af988ba7a8e9c0462078e16e9ba30df4b141a761bcc344c06bb7c passed the unchanged case at 3a7efd7f07 with the red profile.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
